host_load_after_measurement.note: Snapshot immediately after measurement; host load was not controlled.

scope: Reference-evidence withdrawal, provisional rejection recovery and bounded worklist performance
fixture_note: Isolated Release fixture with the previous target-profile and CRC changes plus this change. Relevant signature sources match the review tree. This is not a full build of current dev. CPU/web/Python/Z3 disabled; same pinned LLVM/Capstone and frozen performance libraries as the prior measurement.

host.load_note: Other compile/research processes were active. CPU time separates scheduled work from wall-time noise; this is not an isolated throughput certification.

method.accuracy: Fresh normal CLI sigs --auto --no-debug --json; exact MAP names and aliases are the oracle. Maps do not supply runtime names. These are compatibility probes, not held-out programs.
method.paired_apply: Same process and database, baseline SignatureDB methods linked under distinct symbols; alternating before/after order. One untimed pair then 51 timed pairs, three processes per workload, fixed CPU affinity, one/four workers. Timed region is apply plus buildNameMap, including byte matching and reference resolution. Parsing, index warmup, discovery and hashing excluded. MAP supplies only entry VAs.
method.summary: Median of per-process medians. Every timed pair retained. FNV-1a name digests verify deterministic output separately for each version, not equality between versions.
method.cli: Fresh process, warm existing parsed-file cache, alternating before/after order, one warmup pair plus 11 measured pairs. Wall time and child CPU time include the full command and /usr/bin/time; peak RSS in KiB.
method.limits: Local host load and scheduling varied. These measurements are not a latency guarantee or cross-tool comparison. No new real ELF/Mach-O/kernel/mobile truth corpus was run.
method.work_bound: At most the existing 16 propagation rounds; at most one queue slot per match per round. Only callers reading changed evidence are revisited; overflow suppresses the dependent closure.

validation.sanitizer_scope: SignatureDB.cpp and SignatureDBTests.cpp instrumented with ASan/UBSan; other linked libraries uninstrumented; system allocator.

preliminary_note: An earlier correctness-only candidate showed noisy end-to-end runs, including a 4-worker x86 outlier. It prompted same-process isolation and queue optimizations. All preliminary logs remain in local diagnostic artifacts; do not treat them as the final source measurement.
